mapper.select: SELECT R.REVIEW_ID AS reviewId, R.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, R.PACKAGE_ID AS packageId, R.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, R.ORDER_ITEM_ID AS orderItemId, R.RATING AS rating, R.REVIEW_CONTENT AS reviewContent, R.REVIEW_STATUS AS reviewStatus, DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(R.CREATED_AT, INTERVAL 9 HOUR), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, COALESCE(OI.item_name_snapshot, P.product_name, PK.package_name) AS productName, CASE WHEN R.PRODUCT_ID IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = R.PRODUCT_ID AND PI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PI.display_order ASC, PI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE ( SELECT PKI.image_url FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PKI WHERE PKI.package_id = R.PACKAGE_ID AND PKI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PKI.display_order ASC, PKI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS productThumb FROM REVIEW R LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON R.ORDER_ITEM_ID = OI.order_item_id LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON R.PRODUCT_ID = P.product_id LEFT JOIN PACKAGE PK ON R.PACKAGE_ID = PK.package_id WHERE R.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND R.REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT REVIEW_ID, MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, RATING, REVIEW_CONTENT, REVIEW_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM REVIEW WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET RATING = #{rating}, REVIEW_CONTENT = #{reviewContent}, UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW_IMAGE ( REVIEW_ID, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME, IMAGE_NAME, IMAGE_SIZE, IMAGE_TYPE, DISPLAY_ORDER ) VALUES ( #{reviewId}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOriginName}, #{imageName}, #{imageSize}, #{imageType}, #{displayOrder} )
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW SET REVIEW_STATUS = 'DELETE', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE REVIEW_ID = #{reviewId} AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT OI.order_item_id AS orderItemId, OI.order_id AS orderId, O.order_number AS orderNumber, DATE_FORMAT(O.ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS orderedAt, OI.product_id AS productId, OI.package_id AS packageId, OI.item_name_snapshot AS itemNameSnapshot, OI.quantity AS quantity, OI.line_amount AS lineAmount, CASE WHEN OI.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = OI.product_id AND PI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PI.display_order ASC, PI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE ( SELECT PKI.image_url FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PKI WHERE PKI.package_id = OI.package_id AND PKI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PKI.display_order ASC, PKI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS thumbnailUrl FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.order_id = O.order_id WHERE O.member_id = #{memberId} AND O.order_status = 'DELIVERED' AND OI.is_reviewed = 'N' ORDER BY O.ordered_at DESC, OI.order_item_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEW ( MEMBER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PACKAGE_ID, ORDER_ITEM_ID, RATING, REVIEW_CONTENT, REVIEW_STATUS, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{productId}, #{packageId}, #{orderItemId}, #{rating}, #{reviewContent}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW() )
